title: Early Booking Rate for Homesite Reservation Extension Fees
content:
The extension booking rate on a Homesite Reservation hold extension fee is set by how far ahead of the current hold expiry date the extension is taken: the calendar days from today to the current hold expiry date shown on the reservation.

## Booking-rate schedule

| Calendar days from today to the current hold expiry date | Extension booking rate |
|---|---|
| at least 7 | 50 percent |
| at least 4 but fewer than 7 | 75 percent |
| fewer than 4 | one hundred percent |

## Boundary days

| Days remaining | Rate |
|---|---|
| 7 | 50 percent |
| 6 | 75 percent |
| 4 | 75 percent |
| 3 | one hundred percent |
| 0 (today is the hold expiry date) | one hundred percent |

## Date illustration (hypothetical)

Hold expiry date 17 April. Taken on 10 April: 7 days remain, 50 percent. Taken on 11 April: 6 days remain, 75 percent. Taken on 14 April: 3 days remain, one hundred percent.
